# Enhancelator

The enhancement-strategy mathematics in `src/features/enhancement/tooltip-enhancement.js`
and `src/libraries/enhancement-standalone.js` follow
[Enhancelator](https://doh-nuts.github.io/Enhancelator/) by doh-nuts (MIT) —
the per-level protection matrix, the mixed-strategy minimum, and the `fib()` /
`mirrorFib()` breakdown functions, which were taken directly. Enhancelator
itself credits MangoFlavor for the underlying game mechanic. `LICENSE.md` is
the repository's license verbatim.
